📖 How to use

  1. Pick an order: 3, 5, 7, 9 (odd) or 4, 8 (doubly even).
  2. Press Generate to build the square with the classical method.
  3. Read the magic constant and watch every row, column and diagonal sum checked.
  4. Learn the method from the construction steps shown below.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is a magic square?

An n×n grid of the numbers 1..n² where every row, column and both main diagonals sum to the same magic constant M = n(n²+1)/2.

How does the Siamese method work?

Start with 1 in the middle of the top row, then move up-right for each next number, wrapping around edges; when the target cell is taken, drop down one cell instead.

Why are orders 6 and 10 not offered?

Singly-even orders (6, 10, ...) need a more complex construction (the LUX method). This tool implements the two classical methods that are simple and verifiable: Siamese for odd n and the complement method for doubly-even n.
